basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old recent college grad from Austin, Texas, currently working as a freelance graphic designer. I've always been interested in the intersection of music and visual art, which is why I spend a lot of my free time exploring new music and album artwork. I love late-night browsing on Reddit, usually after 10 PM, as it fits well with my flexible work schedule. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to travel when work allows. I dislike overly structured environments and am always on the lookout for new inspirations and creative ideas.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise mainly lies in graphic design, which I honed through a blend of formal education and hands-on projects. I am self-taught in using design software like Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop, and I often draw inspiration from music and digital art communities.
